name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.4.0 — New «System» column in the Distribute Tasks table (read-only, sortable) makes it obvious at a glance which project/system each task belongs to. Optional «Manual per-assignee resource» mode in plugin settings lets team leads enter the available hours per assignee directly instead of computing them from grade × KPE × rate (grade stays informational). The Resources by assignee table gains a new «Allocations by project» column with a per-system hours/percent breakdown, automatically visible when the System field is configured. Sprint refresh button is renamed «Refresh from issues», and the dynamic editing mode label is rewritten from «Inline editing» to «Direct editing» across all 15 locales. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
